desc: utilty for creating mime-multipart files, likely for use via user data and cloud-init.
u: write-mime-multipart - utilty for creating mime-multipart files, likely for use via user data and cloud-init.

This program is intended to help write data that can be consumed by cloud-init. cloud-init reads mime multipart as user-data.

-h | --help
Show usage message
-o | --output FILE
write output to FILE [default is stdout]
-z | --gzip
compress output with gzip
-d | --default DEFTYPE
if not provided assume mime-type of DEFTYPE [default is 'text/plain']
--delim DELIM
use delimiter DELIM [default is ':']
